SPA Site List Dataset

spalist.Rd

This dataset contains information about Special Protection Areas (SPAs), including site codes, site names.

Usage

spalist

Format

A data frame with the following 10 columns:

SITE_CODE

Character: A unique code identifying each SPA.

SITE_NAME

Character: The name of the SPA.

CEF.include

character: Indicates if the site is included in the CEF project (Y) or not (NA).

Marine.only

character: Indicates if the site is classified as a marine-only SPA.

Altnames.sufficient

character:NEED EXPL

Altnames.SPApolys

character:NEED EXPL

Altnames.SMP

character:NEED EXPL

Altnames.Productivity

character:NEED EXPL

Altnames.BDMPS

character:NEED EXPL

Altnames.FR

character:NEED EXPL.

Source

NEED EXPL
